_comment: This file configures the ADVISOR project only: a second Vercel project on
this same repository whose Root Directory is the REPO ROOT, deploying
api/advisor.py as a Python function and nothing else.
The main site project is left exactly as it is (Root Directory web-next,
no vercel.json). It reaches the advisor over HTTP via ADVISOR_URL, which
the build route already supports, so nothing about the working production
deployment has to change to turn the build tools on.
The function needs the repo-root data files (data/*.json, web/*.py), which
is why its root cannot be web-next: those directories would be outside the
Dependencies come from the repo-root requirements.txt, which is kept down
to `requests` for exactly this reason -- the bundle limit is 250MB unzipped
and the scraper/Streamlit deps live in requirements-scrape.txt instead.
Do NOT set functions.runtime here. Python is detected from the .py
extension; `runtime` is only valid for community runtimes and an invalid
value fails config validation before any build runs.
maxDuration 300 needs a plan above Hobby (which caps at 60s). A real
generation measured 53s, and counter builds with a full enemy team run
longer, so 60s is not enough headroom.
